<!-- Generated by `ovid2 manual gen-reference`. Do not edit by hand. -->

`ovid2 mcp` exposes **101 tools**. Each one is a thin, typed wrapper over a single `/api/v1` call — the agent tier never touches secrets, drivers or pipeline code. Destructive tools stop at a human approval gate. See [Agent Ovid (MCP)](../07-assistant/mcp.md) for set-up.

| Tool | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `assign_transform` | Assign a transform chain to tables of a pipeline: appends {spec: name} to <pipeline>/transforms/assignments.yaml so the pipeline's `transform` stage (between deduplicate and map) runs it. Idempotent. Requires manage_config. | `name`, `pipeline`, `tables` |
| `cancel_job` | Request cooperative cancellation of a queued or running job. Queued jobs are cancelled immediately; running jobs are sent SIGTERM and cleaned up by the worker on the next poll. | `job_id` |
| `check_pipeline_bindings` | Check every name a pipeline package depends on against the rest of Ovid2 — registered CDM, identity constants, engine family, secrets.d salt keys, dictionaries.py names, fixer names / reference tables / list files, formatter class paths and vocabularies, transform assignments. Returns [{id, category, label, value, must_match, status, detail, where}]. Read-only. | `pipeline`, `engine` |
| `create_address` | Create a new address JSON config in the user-scoped configs directory. Addresses are views onto connections: pass the name of an existing connection plus a small location payload. Fails with HTTP 400 when a config of the same name already exists or when the referenced connection is missing. Use update_address for idempotent create-or-update. | `name`, `connection`, `location` |
| `create_connection` | Create a new connection JSON config. Fails with HTTP 400 when a connection of the same name already exists. Use update_connection for idempotent create-or-update. | `name`, `type`, `args`, `secrets`, `secret_ref` |
| `create_engine` | Create a new engine JSON config. Fails with HTTP 400 when an engine of the same name already exists. Use update_engine for idempotent create-or-update. | `name`, `type`, `args`, `secrets`, `secret_ref` |
| `create_pipeline_config` | Create a persisted, named ETL job template. Fails with HTTP 400 when a pipeline_config of the same name already exists. | `name`, `kind`, `cdm`, `pipeline`, `input_address`, `output_address`, `tables`, `transformations`, `engine`, `workers`, `sf_account`, `stderr_log`, `allow_overwrite`, `enabled`, `trigger` |
| `create_report_draft` | Create a private draft report from a template or a full layout (validated against the chart library and the source). Nothing is shared or exported; returns the report and its Studio url. | `source_id`, `template_id`, `layout`, `title`, `folder`, `tags` |
| `delete_address` | Remove an address JSON config from the user-scoped configs directory. System-scoped configs (/etc/ovid2/configs/) are never touched. | `name` |
| `delete_connection` | Remove a connection JSON. Does not delete the referenced secret file — call delete_secret separately if desired. | `name` |
| `delete_engine` | Remove an engine JSON. Refuses (HTTP 400) when the engine is still referenced by any pipeline or by settings.defaults.engine. Does not delete the referenced secret file — call delete_secret separately if desired. | `name` |
| `delete_formatter` | Remove a formatter YAML spec. Python-dict formatter modules (configuration-as-code) are never touched by this tool. | `pipeline`, `table` |
| `delete_mapper` | Remove a mapper YAML spec. Python-dict SPEC modules (configuration-as-code) are never touched by this tool. | `pipeline`, `table` |
| `delete_pipeline_config` | Remove a pipeline_config JSON and its runtime-state row. | `name` |
| `delete_secret` | Remove a secret JSON file from the user-scoped secrets.d/ directory. | `name` |
| `disable_pipeline_config` | Set enabled=false on a pipeline_config; its trigger will not fire. | `name` |
| `edit_report` | Apply Report Studio layout edit ops (set_report, add/update/move/remove section or block, set_visibility). Defaults to a dry run that validates and returns the new layout; save=true stores a new version. | `report_id`, `ops`, `expected_version`, `save` |
| `enable_pipeline_config` | Set enabled=true on a pipeline_config so its trigger fires. | `name` |
| `fs_list` | List the contents of one directory on the host filesystem (the same view the web-tier user sees). Scoped by the ``settings.fs_picker.roots`` allowlist. Returns an FsListing with ``path``, ``parent`` (or None), and ``entries`` (each with ``name``, ``type``, ``is_symlink``). Read-only: no side effects. Rejects paths outside the allowlist with HTTP 403. | `path`, `show_hidden` |
| `fs_roots` | Return the curated starting points offered by the filesystem picker: the operator's $HOME, every allowlist root from ``settings.fs_picker.roots``, every existing disc-connection host_path, and ``/`` as a last-resort. Read-only. When the picker is disabled the response has ``enabled=False`` and ``roots=[]``. |  |
| `get_address` | Fetch one address config by name. Sensitive src_args (password, token) are masked as '***'. To update the underlying value, call update_address with the new value in place of the sentinel. | `name` |
| `get_approval` | Fetch the status of a single human-approval request by id. Returns its action, target, status (pending / approved / denied / consumed), and any decision note. An agent cannot approve requests — approval is performed by a human in the web control panel. | `approval_id` |
| `get_cdm` | Return full metadata for one CDM registered in ovid2.cdm.registry. Includes the ordered table list with composite dedup keys, id columns (patient/encounter/provider roles), reference tables, flavour-of-null sentinels, shared views, and registered valuesets. Use list_cdms first to enumerate known names. | `name` |
| `get_connection` | Return the parsed contents of one connection config. Every value in the ``secrets`` dict is the sentinel ``'***'`` — the server never exposes plaintext credentials via the API. | `name` |
| `get_engine` | Return the parsed contents of one engine config. Every value in the ``secrets`` dict is the sentinel ``'***'`` — the server never exposes plaintext credentials via the API. | `name` |
| `get_formatter` | Return raw text plus parsed YAML/dict contents for one formatter spec (yaml or python source-kind). | `pipeline`, `table` |
| `get_health_report` | Return the data-health report artifact for a run — the per-check summary + metric rows produced by an ``ovid2 health`` run. 404 when the run was not a health run. | `instance_id` |
| `get_job` | Return one job row (JobDetail shape) or 404. | `job_id` |
| `get_job_log` | Return the captured subprocess stderr for one job as a plain-text string. Empty when the worker has not written any lines yet. | `job_id` |
| `get_llm_status` | Return whether the Ovid2 assistant is enabled and which LLM connections it routes to (System 1 first, general fallback). |  |
| `get_mapper` | Return raw text plus parsed YAML/dict contents for one mapper spec (yaml or python source-kind). | `pipeline`, `table` |
| `get_pipeline` | Return metadata plus the formatter/mapper spec roster for one pipeline package. | `pipeline` |
| `get_pipeline_config` | Return the full detail of one pipeline_config: config + runtime state (last_fired_at, next_fire_at, last_job_id). | `name` |
| `get_report` | Return one report: metadata, its full layout and a compact outline with the section / block ids edit ops refer to. | `report_id` |
| `get_report_catalogue` | Return the Report Studio library: chart kinds with their params JSON Schemas, report themes, layout edit ops and export formats. |  |
| `get_report_source` | Describe one report source: its datasets and columns (type, sensitivity, distinct count, ranges / examples). Raw-value columns are masked for agents; rows are never returned. | `source_id` |
| `get_run` | Return the run row for one batch_id (RunSummary shape). | `batch_id` |
| `get_secret` | Return the top-level key names of a secret file — values are never returned by any code path. Use write_secret to update values. | `name` |
| `get_settings` | Return the merged global runtime settings — defaults, worker, UI polling, notifications, retention. Passwords are never returned in this payload. |  |
| `health` | Return the aggregate ovid2 doctor report — Docker, JARs, Snowflake, and permission checks. Response shape matches HealthResponse in ovid2.web.models (worst severity + per-check breakdown). |  |
| `inspect_pipeline_lineage` | Field-level lineage of a pipeline package, read statically (never runs it). Without a table: each table's stages (format, deduplicate, transform, map, fix), ops and assigned chains. With a table: every CDM field and the ordered steps that touch it — op, params, columns read / written, reference tables, whether it drops rows, and the document + path that defines it. Read-only; use it to explain why a field has the value it has. | `pipeline`, `table` |
| `inspect_pipeline_template` | Inspect a pipeline template before scaffolding: every CDM table with its formatter / source-file patterns / mapper / fix chain / assigned transforms, the identity constants (current value + the clone's default), the required engine family, and every name that must match other configuration (bindings with ok/warn/error status). Read-only. | `template`, `name`, `engine` |
| `install_bootstrap` | Run the XDG bootstrap step of the install wizard (idempotent). Creates XDG_CONFIG_HOME/ovid2/, secrets.d/ (0o700), sample disc configs, and a snowflake.json template (0o600). Returns the ordered log lines returned by the bootstrap helper. |  |
| `install_image_build` | Kick off a docker build in the background. Returns the ImageBuildDetail row for the new build (build_id, status, etc.); poll install_image_build_status for progress. | `tag`, `context`, `dockerfile` |
| `install_image_build_status` | Return the ImageBuildDetail row for one docker build. Set include_log=true to also fetch the captured stdout/stderr (in a 'log' field of the response). | `build_id`, `include_log` |
| `install_service_command` | Return the exact `sudo ovid2 service install --user <u> --bin <b>` command the operator needs to run in a terminal. The MCP server never invokes sudo itself; agents should surface the returned command to the user. | `user`, `ovid2_bin` |
| `install_snowflake` | Write secrets.d/snowflake.json through the 0o600-enforced writer. Required keys 'account', 'user', 'password' are checked before the file is written; missing keys yield HTTP 400. | `values` |
| `install_status` | Return the wizard's step-by-step status, derived live from disk on every call. Steps: bootstrap, snowflake, addresses, image, service, pipeline, done. |  |
| `install_verify_pipeline` | Confirm the requested pipeline package is importable under ovid2_pipelines.* and report its formatter/mapper counts. | `name` |
| `list_addresses` | Enumerate every address config discoverable via the XDG search path. Returns a list of AddressSummary objects (name, src_name, path). Values in secrets are never returned by this tool. |  |
| `list_approvals` | List human-approval requests for destructive operations (deleting a secret, connection, engine, pipeline, or address). An agent cannot approve its own requests — approval is a human-only action performed in the web control panel. Use this to check whether a gated operation you attempted is still awaiting approval. | `status` |
| `list_cdms` | Enumerate every CDM registered in ovid2.cdm.registry. Returns a list of {name, version, table_count, has_yaml} objects. Consumed by the pipelines editor to populate the CDM selector and by clients that need to check which CDMs Ovid2 knows about before creating a pipeline with kind='cdm'. |  |
| `list_connection_types` | Return the registered connector types and their field specs. Consumers use this to build the dynamic new-connection form and to validate ``create_connection`` args client-side. |  |
| `list_connections` | Enumerate every connection config discoverable via the XDG search path. Returns a list of ConnectionSummary objects (name, type, path, secret_ref). Credential values are never returned. |  |
| `list_engine_types` | Return the registered engine types (pyspark, databricks_spark, snowpark) and their field specs. Consumers use this to build the dynamic new-engine form and to validate ``create_engine`` args client-side. |  |
| `list_engines` | Enumerate every engine config discoverable via the XDG search path. Returns a list of EngineSummary objects (name, type, path, secret_ref). Credential values are never returned. |  |
| `list_formatters` | Return the formatter file listing for one pipeline. | `pipeline` |
| `list_health_checks` | List the registered data-health checks (PCORnet EDC / Data Curation Query ports plus Ovid2-native panels). Returns each check's id, name, part, operator, and description. |  |
| `list_health_packages` | List the available EDC / Data-Characterization report-cycle packages (e.g. 20r1). Each entry has id / label / released / description / checks, most-recent first. Use an id as the `packages` argument to submit_health to run every check in that cycle. |  |
| `list_jobs` | Return a paginated slice of web_jobs — every ETL job submitted through the web tier, in reverse-chronological order. | `limit`, `offset`, `status`, `pipeline` |
| `list_llms` | Enumerate the LLM connections configured in Ovid2 (role general / system1, provider, model, endpoint). API keys are never returned. |  |
| `list_mappers` | Return the mapper file listing for one pipeline. | `pipeline` |
| `list_pipeline_configs` | Enumerate every pipeline_config JSON on the XDG search path. Returns a list of PipelineConfigSummary objects (name, pipeline, addresses, trigger type, enabled, next_fire_at). |  |
| `list_pipeline_templates` | Enumerate the curated pipeline templates. Returns a list of PipelineTemplateSummary objects (id, source_pipeline, cdm, kind, label, description). Use the id with scaffold_pipeline to create a new ETL pipeline's pipeline package. |  |
| `list_pipelines` | Enumerate every discoverable ovid2_pipelines.* package. Returns a list of PipelineSummary objects (name, mappers_type, default_db, path, formatter_count, mapper_count). |  |
| `list_report_sources` | List Report Studio sources: durable, aggregated datasets published by finished runs (health checks, analysis profiles, run summaries, health trends). No rows are returned. | `kind`, `pipeline`, `q`, `limit` |
| `list_reports` | List the reports visible to the service principal (title, folder, tags, source, version, permission). | `scope`, `q`, `source_id` |
| `list_runs` | Return a paginated slice of the run history, joining the scheduler batch_tracker with web_jobs where available. | `limit`, `offset`, `status`, `pipeline` |
| `list_secrets` | Enumerate every secret file under the user-scoped secrets.d/. Returns metadata (name, path, mode, size, mtime, top-level keys) but never the values themselves. |  |
| `list_transform_library` | List reusable transform chains: the user library ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/ovid2/transforms, scope 'user') and the shipped chains (scope 'shipped', read-only). Each entry: name, scope, description, steps, ops. |  |
| `list_transforms` | List the public, CDM-agnostic transformations library — the menu of general-purpose lazy DataFrame operations (formatting, correction, reshape, sampling) that can be composed into reusable transform chains. Returns each transform's name, summary, category, requires_family, and params_schema. Optionally filter by category. | `category` |
| `ods_describe_table` | Describe one Ovid Data Space table / data file — metadata only, never row values: fields and types, row count (exact or a statistics estimate), size, last modified, created, part files, delimiter, and for databases the table definition (DDL). Response shape: OdsTableDetail { path, connection, type, location, name, kind, format, columns: [{name, type, nullable}], row_count, row_count_exact, size_bytes, modified_at, created_at, ddl, supported, previewable, message }. | `path`, `refresh` |
| `ods_list` | List the children of an Ovid Data Space path. Every storage account is a tree of plain directories; the complete path of a folder / schema is the batch id of a run that reads it, and an address pointing at it is the exact location its data is read from / written to. Response shape: OdsListing { path, connection, type, location, batch_id, address_name, supported, message, entries: [{name, kind, path, type, size_bytes}] }. | `path` |
| `ods_list_dimensions` | Return the catalogue of storage types (dimensions: disc, snowflake, s3, azure_blob, ...) and how many saved addresses use each. Response shape: OdsDimensionCatalog { default_dimension, dimensions: [{name, address_count, default_address}] }. |  |
| `ods_resolve` | Resolve an Ovid Data Space path to its storage account, the exact location under it, the batch id a run reading it gets, and the saved address that points exactly there (if any). No I/O is performed. Response shape: OdsResolveResult { path, connection, type, location, batch_id, address_name, candidates }. | `path` |
| `ods_sample_table` | Return the first rows of an Ovid Data Space table / data file (row values — may contain patient data; use only when the operator asks to see data). REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL: the first call returns {status: 'awaiting_approval', approval_id, action: 'dataspace.agent_row_access', target}; ask the operator to approve that id in the web panel, then call again (each approval is single-use, per table). Approved response shape: OdsTableSample { path, columns: [str], rows: [[value, …]], truncated, limit, supported, message }. | `path`, `limit` |
| `preview_pipeline_file` | Return the text of one pipeline file after path-whitelisting and anti-traversal checks. Content is truncated to a bounded size; the response indicates whether truncation happened. | `pipeline`, `relative_path` |
| `rerun_job` | Enqueue a retry of a finished job (same input, output, tables). The tracker row for the batch is reset to NEW; a new job_id is returned with parent_job_id set to the original. A rerun writes to the same exact output location, so it needs confirm_overwrite when the earlier run's tables are still there. | `job_id`, `confirm_overwrite` |
| `run_events` | Fetch a cursor-paged slice of the JSONL event log for one run. Pass the returned next_cursor as after= to continue tailing. The 'finished' flag flips to true when instance.finished is seen. | `instance_id`, `after`, `limit` |
| `run_pipeline_config` | Convert the named pipeline_config into a JobSubmitRequest and enqueue it. Bypasses the trigger cadence — the pipeline_config runs immediately. | `name`, `confirm_overwrite` |
| `run_timeline` | Return an aggregated view of the full event log — stage counters, per-table status, and applied/skipped/failed fixes. | `instance_id` |
| `save_formatter` | Create or update a formatter YAML spec. The service parses the YAML and validates the parsed document against the packaged JSON schema before touching disk; invalid payloads are refused with HTTP 400. | `pipeline`, `table`, `raw_text` |
| `save_mapper` | Create or update a mapper YAML spec. The service parses the YAML and validates against the packaged JSON schema before touching disk; invalid payloads are refused with HTTP 400. | `pipeline`, `table`, `raw_text` |
| `save_transform` | Create or update a reusable transform chain (a user-defined function built from library ops). Validated server-side: schema, each op's params_schema, and the SQL expression allow-list (no sub-queries / aggregates / reflect / UDFs). Saves to the user library, or as a pipeline-private chain when `pipeline` is given. Requires manage_config. | `name`, `raw_text`, `pipeline` |
| `scaffold_pipeline` | Create a new pipeline package by cloning a pipeline template (or an explicit source pipeline) under a new name. The clone inherits the template's formatters, dictionaries, and fixer chains; its pipeline_settings identity fields are reset to name-derived placeholders (or the supplied identity values), every reference to the template package is rewritten to the clone, and the target CDM binding is preserved. Fails with HTTP 400 when the name already exists or the template is unknown. | `name`, `template`, `source_pipeline`, `cdm`, `identity` |
| `storage_browse` | List one level of a storage account's contents (folders / files / tables). `dir` entries are navigable — pass their `path` back as `prefix`. Returns supported=False when the storage type cannot be browsed. Powers the graphical pipeline/folder picker on the pipeline submit page. | `name`, `prefix` |
| `submit_health` | Enqueue an ``ovid2 health`` data-health run — the PCORnet EDC / Data Curation Query checks plus Ovid2-native health panels. Reads the CDM tables at input_address, writes a durable dcq_results table to output_address, and produces a navigable report at /runs/{instance_id}/report. Returns the job_id and instance_id. | `pipeline`, `batch_id`, `input_address`, `output_address`, `input_connection`, `input_location`, `output_connection`, `output_location`, `parts`, `packages`, `checks`, `prev_input_address`, `cdm`, `engine`, `confirm_overwrite` |
| `submit_move` | Enqueue an ``ovid2 tools move`` job — the driver-native successor to ``ovid2 tools copy``. Same address-to-address one-shot semantics as ``copy`` (bypasses the formatter, mapper, and fixer stages) with two additions: I/O routes through the D3 native drivers instead of the pre-refactor ``BaseAddress`` chain, and a ``strict_types`` flag toggles the D6.0 advisory CDM type check between warn (default) and raise. Returns the freshly-created job_id and instance_id. | `pipeline`, `batch_id`, `input_address`, `output_address`, `tables`, `engine`, `strict_types`, `extra_mounts`, `confirm_overwrite` |
| `submit_run` | Enqueue a new job. The web worker will pick it up and spawn an isolated ovid2 subprocess whose subcommand depends on `kind` (etl→etl, analysis→analysis, dq_checks→dq_checks, copy→tools copy, move→tools move; the deprecated alias `cdm` maps to `etl`). Every address is the exact location its data is read from / written to (pick the DATABASE/SCHEMA or folder as the address); the batch id is derived from the input. An output that already holds tables needs confirm_overwrite. Returns the freshly-created job_id and instance_id. | `kind`, `cdm`, `pipeline`, `batch_id`, `input_address`, `output_address`, `tables`, `transformations`, `engine`, `workers`, `sf_account`, `stderr_log`, `extra_mounts`, `strict_types`, `confirm_overwrite` |
| `test_connection` | Attempt a lightweight round-trip probe on the named connection (HEAD a bucket, SELECT 1 on a database, stat a directory, ...). Returns a ConnectionTestReport (ok, code, message, detail). | `name` |
| `test_engine` | Probe the named engine by shelling out to `ovid2 tools test-engine <name>`. The subprocess builds a session, runs SELECT 1, and tears the session down. Returns an EngineTestReport (ok, code, message, detail). | `name` |
| `test_llm` | Probe an LLM connection: authenticate against the provider and confirm the configured model is available. Runs in an executor subprocess; returns an LlmTestReport (ok, code, message, detail). | `name` |
| `update_address` | Idempotent create-or-update of an address JSON config. Prefer the W7 shape (connection + location); the legacy (src_name + src_args) shape is accepted only when the address already exists on disk in that shape. | `name`, `connection`, `location`, `src_name`, `src_args` |
| `update_connection` | Create or update a connection JSON config. Secrets round-trip via the sentinel '***' so masked reads survive edits. | `name`, `type`, `args`, `secrets`, `secret_ref` |
| `update_engine` | Create or update an engine JSON config. Secrets round-trip via the sentinel '***' so masked reads survive edits. | `name`, `type`, `args`, `secrets`, `secret_ref` |
| `update_pipeline_config` | Create or update a pipeline_config JSON. Recomputes next_fire_at from the supplied trigger; last_fired_at is preserved. | `name`, `kind`, `cdm`, `pipeline`, `input_address`, `output_address`, `tables`, `transformations`, `engine`, `workers`, `sf_account`, `stderr_log`, `allow_overwrite`, `enabled`, `trigger` |
| `update_settings` | Overwrite ``settings.json`` with the supplied model. Consumers pick up the change within one worker poll cycle. | `settings` |
| `validate_formatters` | Run the packaged JSON-schema validator against every formatter YAML in a pipeline package. Returns a FormatterValidationReport listing per-table ok/error status. | `pipeline` |
| `validate_mappers` | Run the packaged JSON-schema validator against every mapper YAML in a pipeline package. | `pipeline` |
| `validate_transform` | Validate a candidate transform spec against the transform_spec JSON schema and the op catalogue before saving or running it. Returns {ok, errors}. Catches unknown op names and malformed steps early. | `spec` |
| `write_secret` | Idempotent create-or-update of a secret JSON blob under secrets.d/. The file is written with mode 0o600. Overwriting an existing file that is not already 0o600 is refused. | `name`, `values` |
